=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:916-941,1718-1742 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The support-checkout wrappers for `post-merge-validate-dispatch` and `fingerprint-cap-block` run `git -C "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src" rev-parse HEAD` without clearing `GIT_DIR` or `GIT_WORK_TREE`, and minimax says the "Verify workflow support source" steps do the same. The codex-agent wrappers prefix this call with `env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE`.
  WHY: If any step in these jobs exports `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE`, the HEAD check reads the PR checkout instead of the verified support checkout and can pass wrongly. The wrapper would then source a PR-controlled `.codex-workflow-src/scripts/<script>` while `GH_PAT` is in the env. Severity disagreement: gemini BLOCKER (conf 4), minimax MAJOR (conf 3), so the highest is used. Minimax notes that nothing exports these variables today. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated this only as hardening (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1), not a current defect.
- tests/test_review_autofix_step_fallback_verify.py:44-50,182-227 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `DEFAULT_WRAPPER_STEPS` excludes `REVIEW_AUTOFIX_SUPPORT_CHECKOUT_JOB_STEP_SCRIPTS`, so no behavioural test plants a fake `scripts/review_autofix_step_post_merge_validate_dispatch.sh` / `scripts/review_autofix_step_fingerprint_cap_block.sh` and runs the real wrapper `run:` text.
  WHY: The structural test only checks that substrings are present. A regression that keeps the shape but verifies the wrong thing, such as reading `SCRIPT_REF` or comparing against an unset variable, would let the #10208 fallback-sourcing defect come back with no test failing. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
